0022600211.text: The Knicks (5-4, 3-2 at home) return home on a three-game winning streak, sitting third in the Atlantic and fifth in the East, while the Bucks (1-8, 1-4 on the road... ) have lost five straight and sit 15th in the East. Josh Hart is day-to-day with an ankle injury and is a game-time decision for New York, and Gary Trent Jr. is out for Milwaukee with an illness. The teams have not met yet this season, but the Knicks won the 2025-26 series 2-1, including a 127-98 win in Milwaukee on February 27.
